left.raw_text: Adult participants with low or intermediate-1 risk MDS
previous treatment with hematopoietic growth factors
Symptomatic anemia (hemoglobin <10 g/dL) as determined by investigator
Serum erythropoietin <500 milliunits/milliliter (mU/mL) within 14 days prior to the first dose of study treatment
Require no red blood cell transfusion or dependent on <4 units within 8 weeks prior to screening

right.raw_text: Clinically stable for at least 1 month prior to entry into the study

left.raw_text: For female participants of childbearing potential and male participants with partners of childbearing potential, agreement (by participants and/or partner) to use highly effective form(s) of contraception
